title: Acoustic Energy Conservation Studio
description: A physics-inspired studio where a BoomBox emits colored energy particles that bounce between a Corset (acting as a reflector dish) and an Avocado (acting as an energy absorber). The user manipulates positions, orientations, and energy levels of all three objects while a strict energy conservation law governs the system. Full undo/redo support tracks every interaction.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive 3D energy conservation studio. Load three GLB models using GLTFLoader: shared_assets/BoomBox.glb (scale 80x), shared_assets/Corset.glb (scale 30x), and shared_assets/Avocado.glb (scale 20x). Place them in a triangular arrangement on a dark grid floor. Setup: PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,6) with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (0.4), a directional light, and a hemisphere light. Display an HTML overlay HUD showing: total system energy (fixed at 100 units), energy assigned to each object, current selected object name, and undo/redo step counts. Core mechanics: The system has exactly 100 energy units distributed among the three objects. Clicking an object selects it (highlight with emissive outline). A slider labeled 'Transfer Energy' lets the user move energy FROM the selected object TO a second object chosen by right-click, enforcing conservation (total always equals 100). Energy level controls each object's emissive glow intensity and a ring of orbiting particle sprites around it (more energy = more particles, faster orbit). Interactions (10-14 steps expected): 1) Click to select objects, 2) Right-click to set transfer target, 3) Use slider to transfer energy between pair, 4) Press R to rotate selected object 45 degrees on Y-axis (affects particle orbit plane visually), 5) Press T to toggle object between grounded and levitating (y-position animates), 6) Press G to cycle glow color of selected object through red/green/blue, 7) Keyboard U for undo and Y for redo — every energy transfer, rotation, position toggle, and color change is recorded in a history stack supporting full undo/redo. 8) Press P to pulse — selected object emits a shockwave ring that visually travels to other objects. Draw animated line segments (energy beams) between objects whose energy exceeds 30 units using BufferGeometry updated each frame. Animate everything in a requestAnimationFrame loop. Ensure conservation law is validated and displayed every frame.
